addition:
candidate_diagnostics records executed candidate Python calls, handled exceptions with propagated library traceback locations, and limited scalar returns in a separate instrumented run. It does not compare intermediate tensors, measure per-site numerical errors, or locate the first numerical divergence. Those observations remain unavailable unless another actual collector supplies them.
For binding_cost, additive means the candidate retains all installed parent bundles and adds new bundles; it does not mean the replacement must add mathematical work. Direct module/project bindings are eligible under this condition, and no functional replacements does not imply zero binding overhead. Removing/replacing an installed parent bundle makes this passthrough comparison inapplicable.
scope: Adaptive clarity check. Qwen comparator is the preceding capability-only probe, adding only the binding-cost eligibility explanation; DDP is a cross-task real-call check against its original saved planner. Not an independently randomized new A/B.
